useCases.name: Product View Abandonment
useCases.desc: When a identified customer views the product/searches the product on the website and abandons without adding the products into cart within 3/custom hours, then trigger personalized communications, encouraging users to add products to cart & complete the purchase.
useCases.pre:
Channels (Email, RCS) should be activated on CE panel.
Events like Add to Cart, Product View, Product Purchase should be passed to Netcore CE panel.
Templates to be uploaded on CE panel by Aristobrat for all channels.

useCases.name: Confirmation email on Order confirmation CEO
useCases.desc: When a customer has made a purchase, send an automated email from the CEO to acknowledge the purchase and a custom thank you note.
useCases.pre:
Channels (Email, Push) should be activated on CE panel.
Events like Product Purchase should be passed to Netcore CE panel.
Templates to be uploaded on CE panel by Aristobrat for all channels.

useCases.name: Cart Abandonment
useCases.desc: Whenever a registered user has added product to cart but doesn’t purchase within 30 mins/custom on the website , trigger communications to encourage users to complete the purchase.
useCases.pre:
Channels (Email, RCS) should be activated on CE panel.
Events like Product View, Add to Cart, Product Purchase should be passed to Netcore CE panel.
Templates to be uploaded on CE panel by Aristobrat for all channels.
Website integration to be competed with the CE panel.

useCases.name: Checkout Abandonment
useCases.desc: Whenever registered user has added to cart and initiates checkout but doesn't complete the purchase, trigger communications to encourage users to complete the purchase.
useCases.pre:
Channels (Email, RCS) should be activated on CE panel.
Events like Product View, Add to Cart, Product Purchase should be passed to Netcore CE panel.
Templates to be uploaded on CE panel by Aristobrat for all channels.
Website integration to be competed with the CE panel.
